AI masks 0x1 (P_SHARED), 0x2 (P_SMT), 0x7F000 (E_CORE) and 0x0 for the no-AI controls; workers on LP 1-11, with LP 1's worker parked in P_SMT and SMT_IDLE; telemetry on LP 19; every affinity call verified.
Both sessions used loop count 338,571. Main pre-test frame 16.10 ± 0.12 ms, largest deviation 2.9% against the 15% tolerance; 0 drift flags in 3,240 tests.
2,160 of 2,160 AI tests ran batched. One output checksum per model configuration across placements and trials (180 of 180), identical in the control session (180 of 180).
At least 1,000 game frames and 50 AI batches per test; 0 tests hit the 300 s cap.
Median trial-to-trial variation is at most 0.6% for mean game frame time and 1.7% for mean AI batch time in any condition.
P_SMT, measured in both sessions, differs by a median -0.8% in game frame time (Spearman 0.99) and -0.8% in AI batch time (Spearman 1.000).
BASELINE frame time does not depend on which condition ran before it (Kruskal-Wallis p = 0.41).

Resolved by the control session: P_SMT is now compared with SMT_IDLE in the same block. The idle sibling alone gives a 13.2 ms P99 against a 9.4 ms median, which is why BASELINE could not serve as P_SMT's control.
Both sessions sat at the thermal limit: package 94.7 and 94.7 °C on average, throttling flag set in 99.9% and 100% of HWiNFO rows, about 45.3 W with PL1 and PL2 at 200 W.
Main-session BASELINE frame time rose about 0.2 ms (1.2%) over 12 h while package power fell 0.6 W at constant temperature. Pairing within blocks limits its effect (drift_order.csv).

Main session: package power and per-core clocks changed only every 80-109 s (median over the test phase; 71-186 s in its first and last hour), so they are used at session level only. Control session: every sensor refreshed every 2 s and is used per test.

PowerMeter reads 0 W in every test, and the ACPI thermal zone, which is not the CPU package sensor, changes only in 1-K steps (per-test means 96.05-97.05 °C); drop both. RAPL package power is valid per test. % Processor Performance is a mean over P-core LPs, so compare it only between conditions with the same busy LPs (not P_SMT against SMT_IDLE).
